column1: # Product and app names that platform repositories (cloud, hands, infra) never contain
# (owner standards/architecture.md, Between products). One case-insensitive Perl regex, a tab, the message.
# A product's need is met by a capability any customer can configure through the public API.
# Boundaries are lookarounds on letters and digits, so `_`, `-` and `.` end a name: KALKAS_NAMESPACE matches.
# Left off on purpose (too generic to be a product token alone): mahjong, tycoon, blackjack, crumple,
# cubit, showhand, holdem, sneak, janus. Their product forms (fun-mahjong, mahjong-tycoon, crumple-keel ...) are listed.
